description:
jquick-thrift is a Thrift communication framework that focuses on low memory consumption and microsecond-level 
	remote procedure call (RPC) processing. It is designed specifically for scenarios that require strict network I/O 
	performance and service stability. While maintaining simplicity in development and zero-cost integration, 
	it provides a Java implementation that delivers native-level Thrift communication performance and ultra-high 
	stability.
